Herbal Volcanic Mud

Our Herbal Volcanic Mud is a rich blend of herbal extracts combined with mineral-rich volcanic mud, designed to be applied directly to the skin. This therapeutic treatment helps to relieve fatigue, ease muscle and joint pain, and soothe menstrual discomfort. The powerful combination of herbal extracts and volcanic mud promotes deep transdermal absorption, drawing out toxins from beneath the skin’s surface. Your body will feel a gentle tingling as the heated blend of herbs work on your tired muscles, warming and detoxifying your entire system. Benefits of Herbal Volcanic Mud:

Water Retention
Reduces edema and lymph stagnation

Womb Care
Improve overall womb health

Constipation
Relieve bloatedness

Muscle and Joint Pain
Pain Relief, Relieve fatigue (Back Spine, Tummy, Knee or Other joint area

Excess Wind
Dispels wind-cold-damp pathogens out of the body

Menstrual Problem
Relieve menstrual problems such as cramps
Cupping Therapy

Cupping uses warm glass cups to create a gentle vacuum, allowing them to ‘stick’ to the skin. This therapy helps draw out stagnation, reduce inflammation, and restore the natural flow of energy. Cupping that supports your body’s self-healing process—perfect for relieving aches, stress, and fatigue.
In some cases, the cup may be gently moved across the skin while suction is active—a technique known as gliding cupping—which helps stimulate the flow of Qi and revitalize circulation throughout the body. Benefits of Cupping Therapy:

Calms the Body
Promotes relaxation and eases stress

Boosts Circulation
Improves blood flow for faster healing

Enhances Massage
Deepens relief and speeds recovery

Eases Muscle Tension
Releases tightness and relieves soreness

Supports Immunity
Helps relieve colds, coughs, and congestion

Aids Detox
Flushes out toxins and reduces inflammation
Guasha

Gua Sha (skin scraping) involves gently scraping the skin with a smooth, flat stone (usually tourmaline or jade) to stimulate circulation and promote healing. This natural therapy helps address a variety of concerns, including chronic pain, inflammation, and muscle tension. Gua Sha is also known to support lymphatic drainage, aid in muscle recovery, and may even alleviate symptoms related to perimenopause. It’s a holistic treatment that revitalizes the body while encouraging balance and overall wellness. Benefits of Guasha:

Releases Tension & Tight Fascia
Eases stiffness and improves flexibility

Stimulates Energy Flow
Unblocks stagnant qi to restore balance

Improves Skin Tone & Firmness
Lifts and sculpts naturally with regular use

Promotes Detoxification
Supports lymphatic drainage and clears waste buildup

Reduces Inflammation
Helps calm soreness and chronic tension

Aids Recovery
Speeds up healing from fatigue, stress, or overuse

Muscle Blade Therapy

We use a warm, specially shaped tool to scrape and glide over muscles and trigger points. The technique targets tight fascia, knots, and soft tissue restrictions to restore mobility and relieve tension.

It’s similar in technique to Guasha, but generally used more for deep tissue work, often with firmer pressure and on deeper muscle layers.

Benefits of Muscle Blade Therapy:

Breaks Down Tough Knots
Effectively targets muscle adhesions that resist regular massage

Restores Mobility
Loosens tight fascia to improve flexibility and movement

Eases Chronic Discomfort
Alleviates lingering aches from stress, posture, or overuse

Supports Injury Recovery
Encourages circulation and speeds up tissue repair

Improves Muscle Function
Helps muscles perform better by clearing built-up tension

Enhances Treatment Results
Amplifies the effects of massage
Infra-Ray Moxa Therapy

A modern adaptation of traditional moxibustion. Instead of burning dried mugwort (moxa) near the skin to generate heat, this therapy uses infrared rays to deliver deep, targeted warmth to acupuncture points or affected areas. It blends Traditional Chinese Medicine principles with infrared technology for a safer, smoke-free, and more consistent treatment.

Benefits of Infra-Ray Moxa Therapy:

Warms the Body Internally
Ideal for those with poor circulation, cold limbs, or fatigue from internal cold

Relieves Pain & Muscle Stiffness
Effective for joint pain, backaches, menstrual cramps, or muscle tension

Boosts Circulation & Qi Flow
Enhances blood flow and energy movement

Strengthens the Immune System
Supports the body’s natural defenses

Improves Digestion & Organ Health
Often used to support spleen, kidney, or stomach functions in TCM

Clears Dampness & Cold
Helps dispel cold-damp conditions that can cause sluggishness or swelling
